mentions.name: BaseRef
mentions.description: This SaaS tool provides requirements, risk, and test management with documentation and traceability for medical device startups. It differentiates itself with reasonable up-front pricing and easy inclusion of traced items in a wiki/Notion-like collaborative document editor.
mentions.problem: Existing competitors in the space are mostly enterprise tools aimed at enterprise customers, leaving a gap in the market for a solid, reasonably priced option.
mentions.audience: Medical device startups, particularly those needing affordable alternatives to enterprise-grade compliance tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m developing BaseRef (https://getbaseref.com), a requirements/risk/test management and documentation SaaS tool focused on medical device startups.
